The item title says "Italy Made," which insinuates that the product is made in Italy. It is not. It is made in China. I guess what's "Italy Made" is the leather, not the wallet itself. This is not just misleading, it's outright deceptive. It irks me when we are not given the correct information to make purchasing decisions. All of that aside, I don't like the design of the wallet. American bills barely fit in the bill pocket, while the credit card slots are too loose. Also, the credit card pockets are not stitched to the edge, which means that a bulky point forms in the middle of the wallet where all the cards pile together when the wallet is folded. I guess this is how they make the wallet "slim," by getting that bulk farther away from where it folds, but I don't see the leather wearing nicely given this construction.
